matrix.question: A multi-tenant Python service on pymongo 4.18.1 builds its MongoDB connection string by inserting a tenant-supplied hostname fragment into the host portion of the URI. Is it affected by the 2026 PyMongo connection-string host injection advisory, and which version fixes it?

Our API uses strawberry-graphql 0.300.0 and every custom permission class declares `async def has_permission(...)`. Is it affected by the 2026 Strawberry advisory where permission checks treat an awaitable authorization result as truthy?
Our Linux-only CI containers install Python dependencies with uv 0.12.10. Are they exposed to the 2026 uv wheel-extraction path traversal advisory?
A PR for a service pinned to Python 3.12 removes `filter='data'` from a `tarfile.extractall()` call, arguing that the safe 'data' filter is already the default. Is that true on Python 3.12?

A Go module whose go.mod says `go 1.21` is now built with the Go 1.25 toolchain. A PR removes `v := v` copies before goroutines inside for loops, saying Go 1.22+ gives each iteration a fresh variable. Does the new per-iteration semantics apply to this module?
Our Quart app is pinned to quart 0.22.0. Is it affected by the 2026 advisory about Quart printing raw request bodies (including passwords) to stdout?

After upgrading the Node HTTP client got from v14 to v15, requests to a legacy upstream that sends a wrong Content-Length header started failing. What default changed in got 15 and how is the old behavior restored?
A CI job sets FORCE_COLOR=1 and a PR upgrades chalk from 5 to 6. Does chalk 6 change how a numeric FORCE_COLOR value and ansi256() colors behave?
Developers run mise 2026.7.10 and open untrusted repositories. Can a repository's local .mise.toml [settings] cause command execution without a trust prompt, and which mise version fixes it?

A Rust service's Cargo.lock pins rustls 0.23.40. Is it in the affected range of the 2026 rustls advisory about TLS 1.3 handshake messages accepted at the wrong encryption level, and can an attacker use it to alter a handshake?

A service using got 16 has a beforeRequest hook that rewrites requests to a different origin (a regional mirror) and relies on the Authorization header set in the original options. What does got 16 do to credentials in this case?
A PR for a Python 3.12 service adds `datetime.datetime.utcnow()` timestamps and compares them with timezone-aware datetimes. What does utcnow() return, and what is its status in 3.12?
When migrating a Next.js 15 middleware.ts that sets `export const config = { runtime: 'edge' }` to Next.js 16, what is the file renamed to and can it keep running on the edge runtime?
On PostgreSQL 18, how can a table default generate time-ordered UUIDs natively without an extension, and does the function take any arguments?
After switching a crate to Rust edition 2024, calls to std::env::set_var fail to compile. Why, and which other functions are affected the same way?
A config file uses TOML 1.1 syntax. Which TOML specification version does Python 3.15's built-in tomllib parse, and can tomllib write TOML?
A project with a .eslintrc.json and ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false in CI upgrades to ESLint 10. Will the legacy config keep working?
After upgrading to Vitest 5, `describe.sequential(...)` in a suite that runs concurrently by default is no longer available. What should replace it?
A CommonJS CLI wants to upgrade to Commander 15. What minimum Node.js version does Commander 15 require, and why?
In a Tailwind CSS v4 project with no tailwind.config.js, how do you add a custom color like mint-500 so utilities such as bg-mint-500 exist?
Node.js throws ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE when our CommonJS code calls require() on an ES module dependency. What causes this error, and which Node flag prints where the problem is in the module graph?
With Docker Compose watch (develop.watch), which action syncs a changed nginx.conf into the running container and restarts the service without rebuilding the image?

Our GitHub REST API client sends no X-GitHub-Api-Version header. Which API version do those requests use, what is the newest version we could pin, and what happens if we pin a version that is no longer supported?
A Go 1.24+ repo still uses a tools.go file with blank imports to pin golangci-lint. What is the current recommended way to track and run tool dependencies, and which go get flag adds one?
